title: Noise Barriers for MRT Tracks at Khatib Station
what_it_is: Noise Barriers for MRT Tracks at Khatib Station

sections.label: Khatib MRT noise barrier tender
sections.summary: The tender for Khatib noise barriers will be called in the next couple of months, with installation around 2020 and completion by 2022.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Transport (a) whether the tender for noise barriers for MRT tracks at Khatib station has been awarded; and (b) when will the work commence onsite and when will it be completed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: We will call the tender for noise barriers for Khatib and other areas under Phase 2 of the programme within the next couple of months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: There has been a delay due to the need to review the effectiveness of Phase 1.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: But more importantly, the timeline for installation needs to be closely coordinated with many other rail maintenance, improvement and upgrading works that compete for the very limited engineering hours.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: We should be able to start installation works around 2020 for completion by 2022.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: When I asked a similar question in August last year, the answer was that it would call the tender in the second half of last year and it would start in 2019.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: It will only be completed in 2022, that is, a few years' delay.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: So, rightly, the Treasury required us to, first, break it up into two phases and to do Phase 2 after we have had a good review of the results of Phase 1.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: That is why there was this slight delay of a few months.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: However, the project has not been completed because there are two sections and we are not the only one to have this where they require higher barriers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: And we were told that this would then have to be covered under Phase 2 of the tender process, which means you now have a barrier system that is half complete under Phase 1.
